title: icacorea dukei
intro: Icacorea dukei, commonly known as the Duke's Icacorea, is a plant species in the Icacuraceae family. This plant has been studied for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Icacorea dukei have been reported to be antimicrobial, antiparasitic, and antiviral, suggesting its potential use in treating various infections and diseases. The bioactive constituents of Icacorea dukei include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its health benefits.
